title: Choose the Analyze layout
question: Three compositions in the Holeshot Settings world. Same job: after a moto, read your line against one rider without a crowded board. Helper copy, S1–S3, and Results may recede; the data stays. Nixie-tube digits wait in the re-roll pool.

options.label: Two acts
options.thesis: The line is one page. The numbers are the next page. Never both at once.
options.viewport: F8 Analyze. Orange Analyze plaque. Icons then lap stepper. Map fills the well with you-orange and Cole-slate lines, scrubber under it, Compare as one menu. No charts, no Results, no S1–S3. A Numbers control opens the second act: SPD | them, GEAR, THR, then traces.
options.risk: A second click to see speed can feel like hiding the compare.

raised.raise: The first viewport has one gravity: the dirt. Numbers wait until you leave that field.
When numbers appear, SPD is huge; helper copy is gone.

options.label: Session sheet
options.thesis: The moto is a timing sheet first. The map is a thumbnail you open into.
options.viewport: Analyze plaque and Hangtown. Huge 1:53.08 for you. Results table as the body (P1 Cole 1:51.42, P3 You gold). A small map sits in the corner. Open map for zoom, scrubber, and At this spot.
options.risk: Riders who came to zoom a corner start on a table.

options.label: Corner desk
options.thesis: The map owns the page. Spot numbers sit in a corner overlay; traces stay closed until Follow.
options.viewport: Map edge to edge under the plaque. Lap stepper and Compare as thin chips on the map. Scrubber along the bottom. A small plaque bottom-right: YOU 1:53.08, Cole 1:51.42, SPD 41.2 | 44.0. No Results. No S1–S3. Follow reveals SPEED / HEIGHT / THR.
options.risk: Overlay type can hide the line it is meant to explain.

options.label: One band
options.thesis: One Analyze fact per band. The next decision is the only one on screen.
options.viewport: Band 1: L1 1:53.08 with < >. Band 2: Compare Cole | 450 | 1:51.42. Band 3: the map as the destination, filling the rest. Spot numbers appear only after you scrub, as a single band: SPD 41 | 44. Results stay on the Review list.
options.case: Holds product clarity: crowded Analyze is too many decisions at once.
options.risk: Stacked bands can read as another Settings list.

options.label: Card stack
options.thesis: Analyze is two cards. Back retraces the exact trail: numbers, then line, then the list.
options.viewport: Card LINE: map, scrubber, Compare. A Numbers button paints to card SPOT: huge SPD | them, GEAR, THR, traces. Results is a third card from the Review list, not this stack.
options.case: Holds clarity: Back is already the product's trail.
options.risk: Three cards can feel like a wizard, not a garage tool.

options.label: Depth dive
options.thesis: You descend: map at the surface, spot at the thermocline, traces in the dark.
options.viewport: Top third: map and scrubber (surface). Mid: one readout plaque SPD | GEAR | THR (thermocline). Bottom: SPEED / HEIGHT / THR traces, dim until Follow. Results and S1–S3 stay off this dive.
options.case: Holds clarity: progressive depth instead of equal-weight stacks.
options.risk: A vertical metaphor is extra if the rider only wanted a quieter map.

options.label: Rain garden
options.thesis: Each cloud pulls a different stream of data toward a habitat.
options.viewport: Map as the only gravity well; numbers orbit until you pin a corner.
options.case: Loses both axes: MX garage is not an impossible garden, and competing pulls recreate the crowd.
options.kept: The first viewport has one gravity: the dirt.

options.label: Telop field
options.thesis: Spot numbers land on the map at the size of the beat.
materials: outlined ExtraBold Italic over the line
options.viewport: Huge SPD over the corner, tiny Cole time in the other.
options.case: Loses both axes: captions over dirt hide the line and shout like TV, not a garage tool.
options.kept: When numbers appear, SPD is huge; helper copy is gone.
